summary: Remote command execution on installer host driven by author-controlled Cloudflare Workers relay
details: Package ships a CLI/daemon whose bundled entry point (dist/bundle.cjs) connects to the author-controlled Cloudflare Workers endpoint https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and exposes tool handlers that call child_process.spawn/exec, powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command with dynamic arguments, and a Python/JavaScript code executor. Messages arriving from the relay drive shell and interpreter execution on the machine that runs the agent, giving whoever controls the relay account arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. A second author-controlled endpoint https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev appears alongside direct provider hostnames (api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.deepseek.com) and, when used, would place caller prompts and BYOK API keys through a maintainer-hosted proxy rather than the direct-to-provider path the README advertises.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
